policy.owner_instruction: nothing should be paid ... cut the probes and make them free.
policy.on_no_free_model: named stop NO_FREE_MODEL_ANSWERED, exit 0 with FREE_LLM_RECEIPT; never a paid model

selection: Strongest $0/$0 instruct models with >=32k context from the snapshot below, ordered by capability; live-tested 2026-10-11 (nemotron-3-ultra and -super answered at cost 0; gemma-4-31b was upstream-rate-limited; openrouter/free is OpenRouter's $0-only meta-router as the last resort). thinkingmachines/inkling:free was excluded: it returned 403 for this account.

paid_probe_lanes.purpose: asks a grounded model whether answer engines cite the authority publications

describes a diff of a tracked USCIS page, quotes verified against the diff
